unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 发现；被发现的事物
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Marie Curie's discovery of radium changed the medical world.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 居里夫人对镭的发现改变了医学界。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dis-(去掉) + cover(盖子) + -y(名词后缀) -> 把盖子去掉，真相就‘发现’了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 讨论；议论
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We had a lively discussion about the class project.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们针对班级项目进行了一场热烈的讨论。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来自动词 discuss（讨论），把 ss 变成 sion 变成名词。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 替换，取代；迫使(某人)离开家园；移动；使失业
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: New machines can displace many manual workers.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 新机器可以取代许多手工工人。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dis-(否定/移开) + place(地方) -> 从原来的地方移开，即‘取代/迫使离开’。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 跳水，潜水 n. 跳水，潜水
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He took a deep breath and made a perfect dive into the pool.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他深吸了一口气，完美地跳入了泳池中。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 发音联想：‘呆、晤’-> 扑通一声‘跳水’了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 纪录片 adj. 文件的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We watched a fascinating documentary about wild animals in Africa.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们看了一部关于非洲野生动物的精彩纪录片。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: document(文件/记录) + -ary(形容词/名词后缀) -> 记录事实的 -> 纪录片。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 捐赠
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many students decided to donate their pocket money to help poor children.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 许多学生决定捐出他们的零花钱来帮助贫困儿童。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音‘都拿它’ -> 把好东西‘都拿它’出来捐赠。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 戏剧，戏剧文学，戏剧艺术
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My name is Lin Hua, and I want to join the drama club.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dra (拉) + ma (妈)，拉着妈妈看戏剧。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 鼓 `v.` 打鼓
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can play the drums.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dr + um，咚咚打鼓的声音。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 预期的 n. 应得的东西；应缴款 adv. 正对着
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The project is due next Monday.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这个项目预定在下周一交（到期）。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：due date（截止日期/预定日期）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 乏味的；迟钝的 v. 使迟钝；使变得无光泽
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The lecture was so dull that some students almost fell asleep.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 讲座太枯燥乏味了，有些学生差点睡着。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：大（d）ull（乌鸦）叫声沉闷无趣 -> 乏味的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 灰尘 v. 擦灰
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She used a soft cloth to dust the old wooden table.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她用一块软布擦拭旧木桌上的灰尘。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 音标联想：‘大湿土’ -> 风吹过到处都是灰尘土。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 鹰
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: fox lion tiger giraffe monkey eagle wolf penguin
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 元音组合法: ea 发长元音 /i:/，老鹰高高飞翔。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 地震
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A strong earthquake shook the city in the middle of the night.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 半夜里，一场强烈的地震震动了这座城市。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: earth(地球) + quake(颤抖、摇晃) -> 地球颤抖 -> 地震。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 生态系统
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: eco (生态) + system (系统) -> 生态系统。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 训练；(在学校)教育；教养
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Parents and teachers work together to educate the younger generation.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 家长和老师共同努力来教育年轻一代。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: e-(出) + duc(引导) + -ate(动词后缀) -> 把潜能引导出来 -> 教育。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 肘；弯头 v. 用肘推
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He rested his elbows on the desk while thinking.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他思考时把双肘搭在桌子上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: el(谐音‘饿’) + bow(弯腰) -> 胳膊肘就像身体弯曲的关节。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 电；电能；强烈的感情；激动
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Water, food, and electricity were hard to get.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：electric（电的）+ ity（名词后缀）= 电，电能。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 尴尬的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She felt embarrassed when she forgot her lines on the stage.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 当她在台上忘词时，她感到很尴尬。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: -ed 结尾修饰人：人感到尴尬、局促不安。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 使人害羞的(或难堪的、惭愧的)；使显得愚蠢的(或不诚实的等)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It was an embarrassing moment when my phone rang during the exam.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 考试时手机响了，那真是一个令人尴尬的时刻。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: -ing 结尾修饰事：事情本身令人尴尬、难堪。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 紧急情况
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Prepare an emergency bag.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：emerge（出现，浮现）+ ency（名词后缀）-> 突然冒出来的大事，即紧急情况。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 皇帝
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: empire帝国的统治者是**皇帝**。
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 百科全书；专科全书
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If you want to know about space, you can check an encyclopaedia.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 如果你想了解太空，可以查阅百科全书。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: en(在...里面) + cycle(环，圈) + pedia(儿童教育) -> 知识环环相扣的百科全书。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 濒危的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Giant pandas are one of the most famous endangered animals in the world.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 大熊猫是世界上最著名的濒危动物之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: en-(使处于) + danger(危险) + -ed -> 使处于危险中的 -> 濒危的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 精力充沛的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I feel energetic after I exercise.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: energy（能量）变形容词 energetic

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 记录；词条；登录
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Read Sam's diary entry.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: en（在里）+ try（尝试）：在入口处尝试进入。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 时代；纪元
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are living in the digital era, where information spreads rapidly.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们生活在一个信息传播极快的数字时代。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音‘依然’ -> 某个时代过去了，但精神依然（era）流传。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 逃走；逃跑
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little rabbit managed to escape from the hungry fox.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小兔子设法从饥饿的狐狸手中逃脱了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: es(出) + cape(斗篷) -> 披上斗篷偷偷溜走 -> 逃跑。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 要点，要素，实质；必需品 adj. 完全必要的，必不可少的，极其重要的；本质的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Water is essential for all living things on Earth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 水对地球上所有生物来说都是必不可少的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: essence(本质、精髓) + -ial(形容词后缀) -> 本质的、不可或缺的。
